provenance: Rig, bone names, bind pose and clips: Actor_B. Body and outfit geometry: tools/character/build_body.py. Weapon models: tools/models.

conventions.space: rig (skeleton) space at the bind pose null-add: +Y up, character faces +Z, character right = -X
conventions.angles: around the torso axis (pelvis-spine chain): 0 front, 90 character right, 180 back, 270 left
conventions.player_note: FrontierPlayer turns the rig 180 deg (model_yaw_offset_deg); these positions are rig-local.
conventions.body: assets/character/actor_b_body.glb via CharacterBodyMesh (helper bones driven as in game)
conventions.clearance_sign: negative = the surface or a limb capsule passes into the item by that much

method.samples_per_clip: up to 6 evenly spaced (every key of the draw clips)
method.posing: channel by channel like the deterministic mixer: rest (= null-add), full-body clip, partial over a base clip at t 0, additive twin as base * rest^-1 * add
method.surface: Clothes + Gear vertices of the torso, hips and upper thighs with outward normals (belt / strap edge vertices dropped), CPU-skinned; signed distance = median plane distance of the 5 nearest
method.limb_note: capsules between joints, radius = 90th percentile of the dominated vertices' distance (middle 60 % of the segment); the thigh starts 25 % down from the hip joint

belt.follows: spinea at its top edge, pelvis at its bottom edge (the build averages the coat weights along the band)

old_powder_horn.reading: 0.19 m long and 6.7 cm tall at the right hip (90-120 deg): with its 5.4 cm base it reads as a round lump; it moves (see carry_points_survey.json horn)

shot_pouch.note: left hip, rigid on the pelvis, hangs from the strap over the right shoulder

bind_landmarks.straps: crossed: left shoulder -> right hip and right shoulder -> left hip, over the coat, y 0.95-1.37

outer_surface.note: outer_r: max radius of the legacy outer surface per 5 cm x 15 deg bin (label = outermost material); skin_proxy_r: customizer body.glb torso (its A-pose arms show up at the sides above y 0.95).

outfit_bulk.note: Outer surface above the skin, in mm, per outfit and region. 'design' values come from the customizer layer envelopes (tools/character/lib/layers.py, customizer_design.md 5.3) and the fur lengths (costume bible 2.4, customizer_design.md 9.1-9.4: belts and straps flatten the fur to 20 %). Stowed items must sit on this surface: stow offset along the outward normal = bulk(outfit, region) - bulk(legacy coat, region). The legacy measured values (legacy_outfit_measured) are the current baked outfit against the customizer's full-skin body.glb as a skin proxy; the two bodies are not the same shape, so they are an upper bound for the legacy coat.

shirt_only.note: shirt / shift worn alone; blousing above a belt up to 20 mm (hunting shirt worn as shirt).

coat_or_frock.note: legacy hunting frock, regimental coats, capots without wrap; skirts free-hanging.

hunting_shirt_outer.note: Doddridge: wide enough to overlap a foot when belted; the bosom is used as a pocket (bloused 15-20 mm more above the belt).

fur_coat_tailored.note: 13-18 mm base + 4 mm hide + pile 20-30 (beaver) / 50-80 (wolf) / 60-100 (bear) mm; under belts and slings the pile flattens to 20 %; a slung weapon presses it about half way.

fur_mantle_or_robe.note: wrap layer: inner >= 22 mm over the outer garment, hide 5 mm, full pile; belted at the waist.

blanket_wrap_matchcoat.note: wrap layer: inner >= 22 mm, 2-3 folded layers of 3-4 mm wool, 10-30 mm drape folds at the back.

capot_with_sash.note: blanket cloth 3-4 mm, bloused above the sash.

bare.note: the bare body v4 (2026-09-28, no garments until the garments pass): the stowed items on the skin

holster_pistol.reading: Keyed with the same value relative to root in every sampled clip: it follows root, not the pelvis, so it slides up to 11 cm against the hip (run-bw-lt) and turns up to 49 deg. In the idle it sits over the right buttock (x -0.08, y 0.85, z -0.13); at bind 3 cm under the coat surface. The source no-pack pistol grab is 13 cm from it: the stowed pistol hangs between holster_pistol and holster_melee.

holster_melee.reading: Same behaviour as holster_pistol (root-fixed). In the idle it sits on the right hip side (x -0.15, y 0.83, z -0.02), 5 cm under the surface at bind; the source no-pack pistol grab is 9 cm from it.

holster_long.reading: Rigid on spineb in every clip (keyed = rest). Its origin lies 6-8 cm inside the back left of the spine (x 0.06, y 1.05): a pivot, not a surface point. The source long-gun and bow grips are 0.30-0.36 m and 0.13 m from it (source_stows prop_in_closest_holster).

arrows:reach_arrow.weapon_prop_bone: r_wrist (reaching hand; the props hold the bow)

arrows:reach_arrow_crouch:crouch-idle.weapon_prop_bone: r_wrist (reaching hand; the props hold the bow)

source_stow_readings.pistol: The game's current pistol actions (pistol/stand/equip etc.) use the BACKPACK variants: the right hand reaches behind to the small of the back (147 deg, y 1.05). The --no-pack variants (same states, Actor_B without a backpack) reach the RIGHT HIP on the belt line: grip at 110 deg, y 0.914, barrel straight down, lock outward, butt to the rear. Frontier has no backpack, so the no-pack clips are the faithful draw for a belt pistol.
source_stow_readings.musket: lg-stealth: the LEFT hand reaches over the left shoulder (wrist y 1.44) to the grip at the upper left back (0.10, 1.34..1.39, -0.09..-0.11); the stowed gun hangs muzzle DOWN. Taken literally with the 1.59 m Brown Bess the butt ends behind the head and the muzzle at shin height (rejected placement back.musket_source_muzzle_down).
source_stow_readings.bow: p-bow-draw-grab / stow-grab: the LEFT hand takes the bow at the left mid back (0.10, 1.17, -0.05); the stave runs from the lower left to behind the right shoulder (prop +Y (-0.46, 0.89, 0.05)).
source_stow_readings.arrows: p-bow-reload: the right hand goes up over the right shoulder (wrist (-0.25, 1.45, 0.06) at 0.3-0.4 s) and pulls up and out (to y 1.6): a back quiver with the nocks behind the right shoulder.
source_stow_readings.throwable: p-molotov-draw^idle: the right hand starts at the small of the back (173 deg, y 1.03) and passes the right back of the belt (149 deg, y 0.92) at 0.2 s on its way forward: usable for a tomahawk at the back of the belt (start the clip at 0.1-0.2 s).

sweep_map.note: Points 3 cm outside the outer surface every 5 cm x 15 deg, carried by the skin weights of their surface vertex. Per group: [min clearance to any limb capsule in cm, limb, clip]. best_rigid_bone / drift: the bone a rigid attachment should use there and how far it drifts from the skinned surface point (play = locomotion, crouch, weapon use; traversal separately).

findings: Belt band: its lower edge follows the pelvis (0-1 cm drift at y 0.85-0.90), its upper edge spinea (y 0.95: 0-8 cm); above 1.05 spinec, above 1.20 spinec / spined.
Hip twist: hip-turning clips (run-bw-lt) rotate the pelvis up to ~50 deg against the spine; items on the belt and items on the back move against each other there.
Sides of the waist (60-120 and 240-300 deg, y 0.85-1.25): the hanging arms and hands (idle), the forearm swing (walk, run) and the elbows reach 3-7 cm into points 3 cm off the surface.
Front below the belt (330-30 deg, y 0.55-0.95): the thighs reach 7-11 cm into items in crouch, running knee lifts and climbs.
Back of the belt below the buttocks (y < 0.65): the heels kick up into hanging items when running (shin -3 to -9 cm).
Clean zones: back 135-225 deg from the belt up to the shoulder blades in play clips; right back hip 125-160 deg; upper back / behind the shoulders for long weapons (rigid on spineb).
Climb / ladder / ledge clips: every back and belt item touches the body or a limb somewhere (-2 to -11 cm); traversal needs the stow pose kept but may nudge items (see hooks).
